text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Define recall aggregation across repeated reviews**

When the same evidence supports the required variance comparison, each configuration has multiple reviews of every head, but this numerator refers to “the configuration's review” without defining how those repetitions contribute. A defect found in only one of five runs could therefore be counted using a union, excluded using an intersection or majority rule, or represented through mean per-run recall, and those choices can reverse the comparative recall result. Specify the run-level aggregation for the recall claim or require a designated single run.
